item.title: Person struck, killed by train in Chester County
item.description: An investigation is underway after a person was fatally struck by a train late Sunday night in Chester County.A man was struck and killed by a train just before 10 p.m. at Lincoln and Marrshallton Road in Caln Township.Police say the coroner was on the scene until 1 a.m. Monday.The man's identity has yet to be released.Investigators are working to determine what happened.
